description: This file defines a set of design tokens, UI components, and style helpers for consistent theming in a SwiftUI-based iOS application, matching Android reference screenshots. It includes color constants, view modifiers, button styles, and layout utilities.

classes.name: AndroidRefCard
classes.description: A container view that applies padding, background, border, and corner radius to create a styled card component.

classes.name: AndroidRefTextFieldStyle
classes.description: A custom TextFieldStyle providing consistent padding, background, border, and corner radius styling.

classes.name: AndroidRefPrimaryButtonStyle
classes.description: A custom ButtonStyle representing a filled primary button with specific height, corner radius, and visual feedback for press and disabled states.

classes.name: AndroidRefChipButtonStyle
classes.description: A custom ButtonStyle for small “chip” buttons, featuring specific font, fill, border, and corner radius.

methods.name: View.androidRefScreenPadding
methods.description: A view modifier function that applies horizontal padding based on theme constants.
